To be done

Recommendations from the session that set up the "session operator" (2026-10-21).
Most of them wait for the cloud experiment (claude/2026-10-21--tmp-transition-to-operator/) to finish.

The cloud environment's setup script (claude.ai UI)

The environment has a setup script that installs Node 26 into /opt/node26. It never puts it on PATH, so it has no effect:
node in a cloud session is still the default Node 22, and nothing in the repo uses /opt/node26.
It cannot block a session (it always exits 0), but after each cache expiry (~7 days) it downloads Node again at session start.

  • [ ] Decide whether Node 26 is needed at all:
    • Not needed: delete the setup script.
    • Needed: make it take effect, e.g. add ln -sf /opt/node26/bin/* /usr/local/bin/.
  • [ ] Keep a reference copy of the environment's UI-only settings in the repo - e.g. claude/cloud-environment/:
    the setup script, and the network allowlist (the hosts to add, from the options' NEEDED_DOMAINS / domains.txt).
    Note there that both must be pasted into the claude.ai UI by hand.
  • [ ] Use the setup script for tools the repo needs but the default image lacks - e.g. gawk (used by scripts/build-prompt.sh),
    if the experiment's findings confirm it is missing. Not for git syncing: the operator's hook does that.

Bun projects in cloud sessions

The TypeScript projects (_DELIBERATION-ROOM, _RTL-EDITOR) are Bun projects: Node only runs tsc, and the compile result
is the same on Node 22 and Node 24 (checked).

  • [ ] A fresh cloud clone has no node_modules: a session that runs these projects must run bun install first.
    The docs mention known Bun proxy issues in cloud sessions - if bun install fails, fall back to npm install.
    Add this to the operator's knowledge (e.g. claude/operator/README.md) once an option needs these projects in cloud.

_RTL-EDITOR type errors (old, unrelated to the cloud)

Nothing runs tsc in _RTL-EDITOR (it has no check script), and Bun does not type-check - so these do not block anything.

  • [ ] public/ (the browser code, type-checked as JavaScript by its tsconfig.json): 86 errors - mostly strictness
    ("possibly null", argument types) in markdown-editor.js, tables.js, app.js, links.js, tab-data.js.
  • [ ] src/ and tests/ are not in its tsconfig.json at all. Checked separately, they have about 24 errors - e.g. findLast
    (needs lib ES2023 or later; the target is ES2022), and implicit anys.
  • [ ] Consider a check script (like _DELIBERATION-ROOM's tsc --noEmit) that covers src/ and tests/ too.
